desc: 蓝天椰影氛围、留白参数卡与徽章阵列，开碗即食卖点一目了然
name: 即食碗装燕窝糖水炖款

shots.intent: 搜索列表首屏干净合规，赢取点击
蓝天椰影氛围下一秒传达开碗即食的核心卖点
放大原料需长时间泡发挑拣炖煮的费时痛点，反衬即食价值
代入午后茶席甜品场景，激发自我投射
微距呈现丝缕与糖水的晶莹质感，证明用料形态
以留白参数卡交代产品信息结构，消除规格疑虑
六宫格阵列一次看全可选规格，方便下单选择
空徽章信任区收尾降风险，临门促转化

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with cloud-blue #BFDCEE, blush-pink #E8B7B4 panels and warm wood #C8965E surfaces
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular medallion icons in one terracotta accent #B03A2E
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with warm window-light scenes, front-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm appetizing tonic-food ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud blue #BFDCEE, blush pink #E8B7B4, terracotta red accent #B03A2E and charcoal text #33383D on clean white #FFFFFF and warm wood #C8965E surfaces; bright soft studio lighting with warm window-light scenes, front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif typography with no brush calligraphy; thin-line circular medallion icon style in one terracotta accent; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements and generous copy whitespace; stable product scale with the bowl as the single hero subject; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brush calligraphy or decorative script
style.presentationRules: bowl shown at stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angles, steady scale across the set, bowl always the single hero subject
style.surfaceSystem: warm wood table #C8965E, matte cream board #F6EFE8 and clean white board #FFFFFF
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for latin and clean rounded sans for Chinese, no brush calligraphy
